title: 037 addendum: indicators and signal pairs vs a gbb-neutral triple-barrier label, with gbb as comparator
status: ADDED AFTER the 037 pre-registration lock (4ccb4ad0) at the user's request; committed before any tb score exists
question: Do any harvested indicators or signal pairs predict a gbb-neutral look-ahead label better than gbb itself (and the width book's entry rule); which columns carry information beyond ARO's own p_buy?

label.why: 034's TB candidate exactly (+2% before -5% within 48 bars; close-based; same-bar tie = 0)

comparators.cmp:width_book: gbb AND bb_width >= the fold's width-book cut (NNNC_LS_CONTROL_SZ.WIDTH_CUTS); E0 rows use f00's cut

rules: the locked 037 rules unchanged: single screen (min_rows, min_fires, max_fire_rate, E0 agreement), pair screen (select on early + E0: min_windows 6, uplift 1.1, min_lift 1.2, top_n 20; confirm on late, E0 >= components); populations all bars (primary) and gbb candidate bars
better_than_gbb: a raw signal or confirmed pair 'beats gbb' when its median lift exceeds the comparator's median lift in early AND late, and E0 agrees (lift >= comparator's E0 lift); reported against both comparators
beyond_aro: descriptive: per test window, AUC within ARO p_buy quintiles (stratified AUC; quintile edges from the window's own rows; nothing fitted); a column 'carries information beyond ARO' when |resid AUC - 0.5| >= residual_min_strength (0.02) in early AND late with the same sign. ARO exists only in test windows, so E0 is not tested
